Rule.Name: BuildSigning
Rule.Description: Authenticode signing of the EXE and its embedded SCR.

BoolProperty.Name: BuildSigningEnabled
BoolProperty.Description: Sign SCR before embedding it in EXE, then sign EXE. These settings apply to both projects and all configurations.

StringProperty.Name: BuildSignerName
StringProperty.Description: Exact certificate common name in Current User > Personal. Specify this name or a certificate thumbprint.

StringProperty.Name: BuildCertificateThumbprint
StringProperty.Description: Optional certificate thumbprint. If both selectors are filled in, the certificate must match both.

StringProperty.Name: BuildTimestampServer
StringProperty.Description: Required RFC 3161 timestamp server URL. Saved locally in FlyingSolids.vcxproj.user. A timestamp is always required.

StringProperty.Name: BuildSignToolPath
StringProperty.Description: Optional signtool.exe path. Leave empty to search PATH and installed Windows SDK versions.
